courses.title: Foundation for Virtual and Augmented Reality Systems

course_goals.text: Define the foundational concepts, scope, and core classifications of Extended Reality (XR) technologies, including the distinctions between Augmented and Virtual Reality systems. (L01, L03).
Analyze the diverse application domains and system categories of XR, demonstrating how different technologies are utilized across various industries. (L02, L03).
Evaluate the overall landscape of XR by understanding its foundational principles, practical applications, and the structure of the field. (L01, L02).

lectures.title: General Intro to XR
lectures.lecture_goal: Explain the foundational concepts, applications, and scope of XR technologies while outlining the course structure.

lectures.title: Application Domains and System Categories
lectures.lecture_goal: Analyze the application domains and system categories of extended reality.

lectures.title: Application Domains and System Categories
lectures.lecture_goal: Analyze the fundamental concepts, classifications, and comparative uses of Augmented and Virtual Reality systems.
